title: Where Is the BEST Place to Study English?
speaker: Tom Wilkinson

keywords.def: the experience of being surrounded by and regularly using a language
communication between people, especially using language
the subjects and content taught in a course
clear and direct, rather than implied
focused on using language for real communication
combining two different methods, especially online and face-to-face learning
adapted to the needs of a particular learner

sentences.en: Where is the best place to study English?
sentences.zh: 哪里是学习英语的最佳地点？

sentences.en: Is it better to move to Britain, the US, or another English-speaking country, or can you learn just as effectively at home?
sentences.zh: 搬到英国、美国或其他英语国家更好，还是你在家里也能学得一样好？

sentences.en: Does studying in person produce better results than studying online?
sentences.zh: 线下学习比在线学习能产生更好的结果吗？

sentences.en: Is a private one-to-one class better than a small group or a large class?
sentences.zh: 一对一的私教课比小班课或大班课更好吗？

sentences.en: What about structured lessons that teach grammar and vocabulary compared with conversation-focused classes?
sentences.zh: 与专注于对话的课程相比，教授语法和词汇的结构化课程怎么样？

sentences.en: In this episode, we’re going to look at the research behind these questions and try to work out what makes an English-learning environment effective.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将探讨这些问题背后的研究，并试图找出是什么让英语学习环境变得高效。

sentences.en: The goal of the episode is to explore what combination of place, teaching, interaction, and practice gives you the best chance of improving your English!
sentences.zh: 本期节目的目标是探讨地点、教学、互动和练习的最佳结合，从而为你提供提升英语的最佳机会！

sentences.en: This episode was inspired by a thought I had while talking to some friends recently.
sentences.zh: 这期节目的灵感来自于我最近和一些朋友聊天时产生的一个想法。

sentences.en: I was curious about which country teaches English as a second language or English as a foreign language the best.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇哪个国家把英语作为第二语言或外语教得最好。

sentences.en: Which country is the best place to learn English?
sentences.zh: 哪个国家是学习英语的最佳地点？

sentences.en: But it turns out there is no simple answer to this.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，这个问题没有简单的答案。

sentences.en: I searched online, I searched on Google Scholar, and I haven’t really been able to find a reliable global ranking that tells us, for example, that Britain is the best place to learn English, or Australia is number two, or the Philippines is number three.
sentences.zh: 我在网上搜索过，也在谷歌学术上搜索过，但我真的没能找到一个可靠的全球排名——比如告诉我们英国是学英语最好的地方、澳大利亚排第二、或者菲律宾排第三。

sentences.en: Rankings such as the EF English Proficiency Index measure how well people speak English in different countries, but they do not measure the quality of English language schools or tell us where a foreign learner will improve the most.
sentences.zh: 像EF英语熟练度指数这样的排名衡量的是不同国家的人英语说得怎么样，但它们并没有衡量英语语言学校的质量，也没有告诉我们外国学习者在哪里能取得最大的进步。

sentences.en: And as far as I could find, there has not been too much academic research comparing educational outcomes for English students between countries, probably because there can be such variance in the level and quality of education within a country.
sentences.zh: 据我所能找到的资料，并没有太多关于不同国家英语学生教育成果对比的学术研究，这可能是因为一个国家内部的教育水平和质量可能存在巨大差异。

sentences.en: Wherever you go, there’s going to be great English schools and also terrible English schools.
sentences.zh: 无论你去哪里，都会有很棒的英语学校，也会有糟糕的英语学校。

sentences.en: It probably makes more sense to ask which countries make it the easiest to create the conditions to help people learn in English.
sentences.zh: 问哪个国家最容易创造条件帮助人们用英语学习，可能更有意义。

sentences.en: The obvious choices are places where English is the dominant language: the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Ireland.
sentences.zh: 显而易见的选择是英语占主导地位的地方：英国、美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、新西兰和爱尔兰。

sentences.en: Probably those countries. Maybe South Africa as well.
sentences.zh: 可能就是这些国家。也许还有南非。

sentences.en: Studying in those countries gives you opportunities to encounter English outside of your classroom.
sentences.zh: 在这些国家学习为你提供了在教室之外接触英语的机会。

sentences.en: You can hear English every day. But there are other options and countries out there.
sentences.zh: 你每天都能听到英语。但外面还有其他的选择和国家。

sentences.en: I’ve talked about Malta before many years ago on this podcast.
sentences.zh: 几年前我在这个播客里聊过马耳他。

sentences.en: Or there’s the Philippines. The Philippines has a very large English language education industry, particularly aimed at international students from East Asia.
sentences.zh: 或者还有菲律宾。菲律宾拥有非常庞大的英语教育产业，特别是针对来自东亚的国际学生。

sentences.en: There are a lot of English schools aimed at Japanese and Korean students.
sentences.zh: 有很多针对日本和韩国学生的英语学校。

sentences.en: And the cost of studying in the Philippines or in Malta, for example, can be lower than studying in Britain or Australia.
sentences.zh: 例如，在菲律宾或马耳他学习的成本可能比在英国或澳大利亚学习要低。

sentences.en: The best country for you is probably the country where you can combine the best level of education you can afford, with some interaction outside of the classroom, and an affordable lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 对你来说最好的国家，可能是一个能将你负担得起的最高水平教育、课外互动以及负担得起的生活方式结合起来的国家。

sentences.en: There is a related question here though, which I can answer trying to use some research.
sentences.zh: 不过，这里还有一个相关的问题，我可以试着利用一些研究来回答。

sentences.en: Does studying English in an English-speaking country help you learn faster?
sentences.zh: 在英语国家学习英语能帮你学得更快吗？

sentences.en: Is there actually an advantage to studying abroad?
sentences.zh: 出国留学真的有优势吗？

sentences.en: It’s definitely a common assumption that the best way to improve your English is to leave your home country and immerse yourself in Britain or the United States or Canada or any other English-speaking country.
sentences.zh: 提高英语最好的方式是离开祖国，让自己沉浸在英国、美国、加拿大或任何其他英语国家，这绝对是一个普遍的假设。

sentences.en: Researchers have studied this. They’ve actually compared students who study abroad with similar students who remain at home, and the results are quite interesting.
sentences.zh: 研究人员对此进行了研究。他们实际上对比了出国留学的学生和留在国内的类似学生，结果相当有趣。

sentences.en: For example, I found a 2024 meta-analysis.
sentences.zh: 例如，我找到了一份2024年的元分析（meta-analysis）。

sentences.en: I’m gonna use the word meta-analysis quite often in this episode.
sentences.zh: 我在这期节目里会经常用到“元分析”这个词。

sentences.en: A meta-analysis is a research paper that looks at other research papers and sees if there’s any trends in the studies and research.
sentences.zh: 元分析是一种研究论文，它回顾了其他研究论文，看看研究中是否存在任何趋势。

sentences.en: The 2024 meta-analysis that I found was published in The Oxford Review of Education, and it looked at 14 different studies.
sentences.zh: 我找到的2024年元分析发表在《牛津教育评论》上，它研究了14项不同的研究。

sentences.en: These studies compared studying abroad with studying at home for language learning.
sentences.zh: 这些研究对比了语言学习中出国留学与国内学习的区别。

sentences.en: And across the 14 studies, they found a medium advantage for studying abroad, particularly in the development of second language fluency.
sentences.zh: 在这14项研究中，他们发现出国留学具有中等程度的优势，尤其是在第二语言流利度的发展方面。

sentences.en: In other words, there is evidence that going abroad to study a language can make a meaningful difference.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，有证据表明出国学习语言能产生有意义的影响。

sentences.en: But that isn’t the full story. Simply being in an English-speaking country doesn’t guarantee you’re going to be better at English.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是全部。仅仅身处一个英语国家并不能保证你的英语会更好。

sentences.en: What matters is what you actually do there.
sentences.zh: 重要的是你在那里实际做了什么。

sentences.en: Who do you live with? Who are your friends?
sentences.zh: 你和谁住在一起？你的朋友是谁？

sentences.en: How much English do you use outside the classroom?
sentences.zh: 你在课堂之外使用多少英语？

sentences.en: How much contact do you have with local speakers?
sentences.zh: 你和当地人接触有多少？

sentences.en: Study abroad students who have greater interaction with local people tend to benefit more.
sentences.zh: 与当地人有更多互动的留学生往往受益更多。

sentences.en: Accommodation can make a big difference there.
sentences.zh: 住宿在那里面能产生巨大的差异。

sentences.en: In particular, living with a host family can give you a much greater opportunity for communication than living with other international students.
sentences.zh: 特别是，寄宿家庭能比和其他国际学生合住提供多得多的交流机会。

sentences.en: The evidence suggests that studying abroad does have an advantage for your English learning, but the advantage comes from the increased opportunities to use English, not simply from being in a foreign country.
sentences.zh: 证据表明，出国留学对你的英语学习确实有优势，但这种优势来自于使用英语的机会增加，而不仅仅是因为身处外国。

sentences.en: If you go abroad and you don’t interact with people or use English at all, you’re not going to improve as much.
sentences.zh: 如果你出了国却不与人互动，也不使用英语，你的进步就不会那么大。

sentences.en: The next question I want to think about is where the actual English lesson takes place.
sentences.zh: 我想考虑的下一个问题是，实际的英语课在哪里上。

sentences.en: If you want to improve your English, is it better to sit in a classroom with a teacher and other students?
sentences.zh: 如果你想提高英语，是和一个老师还有其他学生一起坐在教室里更好吗？

sentences.en: Or can you get the same result through a computer screen?
sentences.zh: 还是你可以通过电脑屏幕获得同样的效果？

sentences.en: There is something intuitive about in-person classes.
sentences.zh: 线下课程有一种直观的优势。

sentences.en: You are physically present with a teacher and surrounded by other students.
sentences.zh: 你与老师同处一室，身边环绕着其他学生。

sentences.en: Online learning can seem a bit less serious.
sentences.zh: 在线学习可能会显得没那么严肃。

sentences.en: There are distractions at home. People have technical problems.
sentences.zh: 家里有各种干扰。人们会有技术问题。

sentences.en: There’s probably fewer opportunities for natural interaction.
sentences.zh: 自然互动的机会可能更少。

sentences.en: You’re behind a screen. But when researchers actually compare online versus in-person study, the answer to which one is the best is not straightforward.
sentences.zh: 你隔着一个屏幕。但是，当研究人员真正对比线上和线下学习时，哪种最好的答案并不简单。

sentences.en: One important distinction is between online learning in general and what’s called synchronous online language teaching.
sentences.zh: 一个重要的区别是一般的在线学习和所谓的同步在线语言教学。

sentences.en: Online learning is what you’re doing right now.
sentences.zh: 在线学习就是你现在正在做的事情。

sentences.en: You are listening to this podcast. That’s very different from having a live 60-minute conversation with a teacher and three other students on Zoom.
sentences.zh: 你正在听这个播客。这和在Zoom上与一个老师以及其他三个学生进行60分钟的实时对话有很大不同。

sentences.en: When we’re interested in language learning, that distinction is important because interaction is a incredibly important part of language practice.
sentences.zh: 当我们对语言学习感兴趣时，这种区别很重要，因为互动是语言练习中极其重要的一部分。

sentences.en: We’re interested in that synchronous, which means at the same time, online language teaching.
sentences.zh: 我们感兴趣的是同步的——也就是在同一时间的——在线语言教学。

sentences.en: Research on computer-assisted language learning has generally found that technology can produce positive learning outcomes.
sentences.zh: 关于计算机辅助语言学习的研究普遍发现，科技可以产生积极的学习成果。

sentences.en: A large meta-analysis of studies of computer-assisted English instruction by Sharifi et al. found that technology-based instruction can be effective, although the results varied depending on the technology and, more importantly, how the technology was used.
sentences.zh: 沙里菲（Sharifi）等人对计算机辅助英语教学研究的大型元分析发现，基于科技的教学可以是有效的，尽管结果因科技本身以及更重要的是如何使用科技而异。

sentences.en: Research specifically on video conferencing by Li-Tang Yu is also quite encouraging.
sentences.zh: 李唐宇（Li-Tang Yu）专门针对视频会议的研究也相当令人鼓舞。

sentences.en: Their meta-analysis examining video conferencing for second language learning found positive effects, including improvements in listening and speaking.
sentences.zh: 他们的元分析考察了用于第二语言学习的视频会议，发现了积极的效果，包括听力和口语的提高。

sentences.en: The evidence base was relatively small, so we shouldn’t overstate the conclusions of that study, but it does support the idea that learning through a screen is not inferior to learning in person.
sentences.zh: 证据基础相对较小，所以我们不应夸大该研究的结论，但它确实支持了通过屏幕学习并不逊色于线下学习的观点。

sentences.en: It could be just as good. There is also evidence about hybrid learning.
sentences.zh: 它可能一样好。也有关于混合式学习的证据。

sentences.en: Hybrid learning is where students combine online and face-to-face instruction.
sentences.zh: 混合式学习是指学生将在线教学和面对面教学结合起来。

sentences.en: A meta-analysis published in the Modern Language Journal in 2021 compared hybrid language instruction with traditional face-to-face instruction and found only a relatively small difference between the approaches.
sentences.zh: 2021年发表在《现代语言杂志》上的一项元分析对比了混合式语言教学与传统的面对面教学，发现这两种方法之间的差异相对较小。

sentences.en: Basically, adding an online component doesn’t automatically make language learning worse.
sentences.zh: 基本上，增加在线环节并不会自动让语言学习变差。

sentences.en: One major advantage of online classes is access.
sentences.zh: 在线课程的一个主要优势是获取便利。

sentences.en: If you live in a country where there are not many highly qualified English teachers, studying online lets you find teachers from anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 如果你住在一个没有很多高水平合格英语老师的国家，在线学习能让你找到来自世界各地的老师。

sentences.en: Online learning can also make individualized or personal instruction easier.
sentences.zh: 在线学习还可以使个性化或一对一教学变得更容易。

sentences.en: Here, instruction means teaching. You can also combine different kinds of instruction: perhaps a private lesson for your pronunciation and grammar, a small conversation group for your fluency, and independent study for your vocabulary and listening.
sentences.zh: 这里的instruction指的是教学。你还可以结合不同种类的教学：也许是一节纠正发音和语法的私教课，一个提高流利度的小型对话小组，以及用于词汇和听力的自主学习。

sentences.en: But in-person learning has advantages too.
sentences.zh: 但线下学习也有优势。

sentences.en: The biggest advantage is social interaction.
sentences.zh: 最大的优势是社交互动。

sentences.en: In a physical classroom, you might chat with your friend before your class starts.
sentences.zh: 在一个实体的教室里，你可能会在上课前和朋友聊聊天。

sentences.en: You might discuss something during a break.
sentences.zh: 你们可能会在课间讨论点什么。

sentences.en: Maybe you make friends and you continue speaking English after the lesson.
sentences.zh: 也许你交到了朋友，下课后继续说英语。

sentences.en: And if you’re studying abroad, that interaction can continue when you leave the school.
sentences.zh: 如果你在国外留学，当你离开学校时，这种互动还可以继续。

sentences.en: When I was studying in Japan, I was not studying Japanese technically, I was a research student, but I did take a Japanese class and I talked exclusively in Japanese to everyone in that classroom.
sentences.zh: 我在日本学习时，严格来说我不是在学日语，我是一名研究生，但我确实上过日语课，而且我在那个教室里和所有人都只用日语交流。

sentences.en: I would talk with another British person, but our entire friendship was conducted in Japanese.
sentences.zh: 我会和另一个英国人交谈，但我们的整个友谊都是用日语进行的。

sentences.en: This is important because one of the weaknesses of online learning is that the lesson can be, and often is, isolated from the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 这一点很重要，因为在线学习的缺点之一是，课程可以——而且经常是——与你生活的其余部分隔离开来的。

sentences.en: You finish your Zoom call and then immediately return to your native language.
sentences.zh: 你结束了Zoom通话，然后立刻回到了你的母语中。

sentences.en: An online student might have better teaching quality than someone at a physical language school because they can have access to the best teacher in the world, find them online, and have highly personalized lessons.
sentences.zh: 在线学生的教学质量可能比实体语言学校的学生更好，因为他们可以接触到世界上最好的老师，在网上找到他们，并获得高度个性化的课程。

sentences.en: But the student at the physical school might have more opportunities to use English outside of the classroom.
sentences.zh: 但实体学校的学生可能有更多在课外使用英语的机会。

sentences.en: That’s why hybrid learning is potentially really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么混合式学习真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Mixing online and in-person classes. You could have the convenience of online education and also have opportunities for face-to-face interaction.
sentences.zh: 将线上和线下课程结合起来。你可以享受在线教育的便利，同时也拥有面对面互动的机会。

sentences.en: I’m not sure how that would work in practice, but it sounds like a cool idea.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定这在实践中会如何运作，但听起来是个很酷的主意。

sentences.en: Let’s move on now from where you study to who you study with.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们从你在哪里学习转向你和谁一起学习。

sentences.en: When you choose an English class, there are so many choices.
sentences.zh: 当你选择英语课时，有这么多的选择。

sentences.en: For example, you could go onto italki or Preply and choose a private English teacher.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可以上italki或Preply选择一个私人英语老师。

sentences.en: Or you could go to Lingoda or Peter, my recommended English teacher, Peter’s English classes, and you could join a group class.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以去Lingoda或Peter（我推荐的英语老师）的Peter英语课堂，参加一个小组课。

sentences.en: You have options for group classes, private classes, individual classes, classes with maybe two students in, or classes with five students in, or classes with ten students in.
sentences.zh: 你有小组课、私人课、一对一课、两名学生的课、五名学生的课或十名学生的课等各种选择。

sentences.en: Which is likely to produce better results?
sentences.zh: 哪种更有可能产生更好的结果？

sentences.en: What is better, a one-to-one class or a group class?
sentences.zh: 什么更好，一对一课还是小组课？

sentences.en: In a private lesson, the teacher has your complete attention.
sentences.zh: 在一对一私教课中，老师会全神贯注于你。

sentences.en: Every activity can be adapted to your level and, in theory, you can spend most of the lesson speaking.
sentences.zh: 每一个活动都可以根据你的水平进行调整，理论上，你可以把大部分课堂时间都用来发言。

sentences.en: In a group, you have to share the teacher’s time with everyone else.
sentences.zh: 在一个小组里，你必须和所有人分享老师的时间。

sentences.en: But language learning has an interesting feature that I think people forget about: other students are not a disadvantage.
sentences.zh: 但语言学习有一个有趣的特点，我认为人们往往会忘记：其他学生并不是劣势。

sentences.en: Being in a group is actually an advantage for learning a language.
sentences.zh: 身处小组中实际上是学习语言的一个优势。

sentences.en: They can be part of the learning process.
sentences.zh: 他们可以成为学习过程的一部分。

sentences.en: In a one-to-one class, the teacher can control the conversation.
sentences.zh: 在一对一课堂中，老师可以控制对话。

sentences.en: If you make a mistake, the teacher can correct you immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果你犯了错误，老师可以立即纠正你。

sentences.en: That’s great. If you don’t understand something, the teacher can stop and explain it.
sentences.zh: 这很好。如果你有什么不懂的地方，老师可以停下来解释。

sentences.en: That’s great. This makes private lessons useful for individualized instruction.
sentences.zh: 这很好。这使得私教课对于个性化教学非常有用。

sentences.en: Private classes can also give you much more opportunity to produce language.
sentences.zh: 私教课还可以为你提供更多输出语言的机会。

sentences.en: In a one-to-one class, you’ll spend hopefully over 50% of the class speaking directly to the teacher.
sentences.zh: 在一对一课堂中，你希望有超过50%的时间直接和老师对话。

sentences.en: However, speaking to a teacher is not the same thing as communicating with other learners.
sentences.zh: 然而，和老师对话并不等同于和其他学习者交流。

sentences.en: Teachers, especially trained and experienced teachers, are usually great at understanding broken English.
sentences.zh: 老师，尤其是受过训练且经验丰富的老师，通常很擅长听懂断断续续的英语。

sentences.en: Teachers are pretty good at comprehending a variety of different accents and also interpreting your mistakes.
sentences.zh: 老师非常擅长理解各种不同的口音，也能解读你的错误。

sentences.en: Normal people aren’t. I’ve heard this from people who have talked with me in the past.
sentences.zh: 普通人可做不到。我从过去和我交谈过的人那里听到过这一点。

sentences.en: They can have a great conversation with me, but then they go out into the real world and they struggle.
sentences.zh: 他们可以和我进行一次很棒的对话，但一旦走到现实世界中，他们就挣扎了。

sentences.en: I’m not an English teacher anymore, but I do run my conversation clubs and this podcast, and I spend my entire life in a non-English-speaking country.
sentences.zh: 我不再是一名英语老师了，但我确实经营着我的对话俱乐部和这个播客，我的整个生活都在一个非英语国家度过。

sentences.en: I’m pretty good at understanding English from people who are not native speakers.
sentences.zh: 我很擅长听懂非母语人士说的英语。

sentences.en: But if you went to talk to perhaps some members of my family or people I went to school with, you’d have a much more challenging time potentially because they’re not as experienced at listening to non-native English accents or dealing with the mistakes that non-native speakers make.
sentences.zh: 但如果你去和我的一些家人或我上学时的同学谈话，你可能会遇到更大的挑战，因为他们没有那么多聆听非英语母语口音或应对非母语者所犯错误的经验。

sentences.en: Teachers are. People who work in education are.
sentences.zh: 老师们有。教育工作者有。

sentences.en: When you talk to another student, it’s actually a good challenge.
sentences.zh: 当你和另一个学生交谈时，这其实是一个很好的挑战。

sentences.en: You have to deal with their way of speaking.
sentences.zh: 你必须应对他们的说话方式。

sentences.en: Compared to a teacher, your classmate’s ability in English is going to be weaker, and you’ll need to use and develop new skills to communicate with each other.
sentences.zh: 与老师相比，你的同学的英语能力较弱，你需要使用并发展新的技能来彼此沟通。

sentences.en: Basically, private lessons maximize individual attention.
sentences.zh: 基本上，私教课最大限度地增加了个人关注。

sentences.en: Group lessons create more opportunities for you to interact with people.
sentences.zh: 小组课为你创造了更多与人互动地机会。

sentences.en: A class with two, three, or four students can combine the advantages of both approaches, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为，有两名、三名或四名学生的班级可以结合这两种方法的优势。

sentences.en: The teacher can give relatively individualized feedback and students, you still have other people to communicate with.
sentences.zh: 老师可以给予相对个性化的反馈，而学生们，你们依然有其他人可以交流。

sentences.en: It would be too strong to say that research has definitely established four students, for example, as the perfect class size.
sentences.zh: 如果硬说研究已经明确确定比如四个学生是完美的班级规模，那就太绝对了。

sentences.en: There isn’t really a simple answer to how big is the best class size.
sentences.zh: 关于多大的班级规模最好，其实没有简单的答案。

sentences.en: In fact, research suggests class size doesn’t necessarily matter.
sentences.zh: 事实上，研究表明班级规模并不一定重要。

sentences.en: The more useful variable, according to research, is how much meaningful participation each student gets.
sentences.zh: 根据研究，更有用的变量是每个学生能获得多少有意义的参与度。

sentences.en: A group of six highly engaged students who spend most of the lesson speaking to each other will probably get better language practice than a group of three students who spend most of the time listening to their teacher.
sentences.zh: 一组六个高度投入的学生，把大部分课堂时间用来互相交谈，可能比一组三个把大部分时间用来听老师讲课的学生获得更好的语言练习。

sentences.en: And a one-to-one lesson can also be poorly designed.
sentences.zh: 而且一堂一对一的课也可能设计得很糟糕。

sentences.en: If the teacher spends 40 minutes explaining grammar while the student listens, the fact there is only one student doesn’t make that lesson more communicative.
sentences.zh: 如果老师花40分钟解释语法，而学生只是听着，只有一个学生这一事实并不能让这堂课更有交际性。

sentences.en: When you’re choosing a teacher on italki or on Preply, or if you want to book lessons with someone I recommend, make sure to choose an experienced teacher, someone with great reviews, because there are lots of people out there who don’t know how to structure a lesson effectively.
sentences.zh: 当你在italki或Preply上选择老师，或者你想预订我推荐的人的课程时，一定要选择经验丰富的老师、有好评的老师，因为外面有很多人并不知道如何有效地组织一堂课。

sentences.en: And actually, we’ll get to that now because when you choose a teacher online, often the default type of class you’re selecting is a conversation class.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们现在就来谈谈这个，因为当你在线选择老师时，你通常默认选择的课程类型是对话课。

sentences.en: But what type of class is the best? If you attend a language school, you’re probably going to follow a strict and structured curriculum, probably based on a textbook.
sentences.zh: 但哪种类型的课最好呢？如果你去语言学校，你可能会遵循严格且结构化的课程大纲，很可能是基于一本教科书。

sentences.en: I did this when I lived in Taiwan. I was at a language school in Taiwan studying Chinese for six months, and we had a textbook, and every day we would work our way through the textbook.
sentences.zh: 我住在台湾时就是这么做的。我在台湾的一家语言学校学了六个月的中文，我们有一本教科书，每天我们都会学完整本教科书。

sentences.en: The structure of the lesson was basically learning a particular grammar point, studying some new vocabulary, practicing it in exercises and with our classmates, and completing more activities so that we could understand it, sometimes doing a project or something.
sentences.zh: 课程的结构基本上是学习特定的语法点、学习一些新词汇、在练习中和同学一起练习，以及完成更多的活动以便我们能理解它，有时还要做一个项目什么的。

sentences.en: But it was all structured around a planned curriculum.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都是围绕着一个有计划的课程大纲构建的。

sentences.en: If you were to find a teacher on something like italki, Preply, or Cambly, especially a cheaper teacher, someone who charges a lower amount per hour, most of the time they are not going to provide a formal curriculum because planning and designing classes takes time and it’s expensive.
sentences.zh: 如果你在italki、Preply或Cambly之类的地方找老师，尤其是更便宜的老师、按小时收费较低的人，大多数时候他们不会提供正式的课程大纲，因为规划和设计课程需要时间而且成本很高。

sentences.en: if you find a cheaper teacher online, you probably will just spend an hour talking to the teacher about interesting topics.
sentences.zh: 如果你在网上找一个便宜的老师，你可能只会花一个小时和老师聊有趣的话题。

sentences.en: Which is better? Which class is better? Are free conversation classes better than curriculum-based classes?
sentences.zh: 哪个更好？哪种课更好？免费对话课比基于大纲的课程更好吗？

sentences.en: Well, there is strong evidence that explicit instruction, directly teaching things like grammar and vocabulary and language, works well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有强有力的证据表明，显性教学（explicit instruction）——直接教授语法、词汇和语言等东西——效果很好。

sentences.en: Directly teaching works well. A 2024 meta-analysis which covered 28 studies and 3,700 learners found a positive effect for explicit instruction in second language learning.
sentences.zh: 直接教学效果很好。一项涵盖28项研究和3700名学习者的2024年元分析发现，显性教学对第二语言学习有积极的影响。

sentences.en: Another study published a few years earlier by Norris and Ortega found similar things.
sentences.zh: 诺里斯（Norris）和奥尔特加（Ortega）几年后发表的另一项研究也发现了类似的结果。

sentences.en: Basically, you want your teacher to directly teach you.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你希望你的老师直接教你。

sentences.en: There is an idea out there that you can learn a language by being exposed to it and by communicating.
sentences.zh: 有一种观点认为，你可以通过接触语言和交流来学习一门语言。

sentences.en: You can learn through conversation only.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以通过对话来学习。

sentences.en: Research suggests that might not be the best approach.
sentences.zh: 研究表明这可能不是最佳方法。

sentences.en: It still works, but direct and formal instruction, like using a clear curriculum, is definitely effective There are reasons for this.
sentences.zh: 它依然有效，但直接且正式的教学，比如使用清晰的课程大纲，绝对是有效的，这背后是有原因的。

sentences.en: If you’re making the same mistakes repeatedly, just having more conversations won’t guarantee that you’ll notice the problem and fix your problem, You need someone to explicitly instruct you and teach you on the grammar to make sure that you are improving.
sentences.zh: 如果你在反复犯同样的错误，仅仅进行更多对话并不能保证你会注意到问题并解决问题，你需要有人明确指导并教你语法，以确保你在进步。

sentences.en: On the other hand, knowing how English works is not the same as being able to use English.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，了解英语如何运作并不等于能够使用英语。

sentences.en: Just studying English theory, using a textbook by yourself, is not really going to help you speak English.
sentences.zh: 仅仅研究英语理论、自己使用教科书，并不能真正帮你说英语。

sentences.en: This is why communicative and task-based approaches to learning English have become really popular.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么以交际和任务为基础的英语学习方法变得非常受欢迎的原因。

sentences.en: Task-based learning tries to give students a reason to learn English.
sentences.zh: 任务型学习试图给学生一个学习英语的理由。

sentences.en: For example, you might have to plan a holiday with a limited budget, or decide who gets a job, or debate how a city should spend its money.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可能必须以有限的预算策划一次假期，或者决定谁能得到一份工作，或者辩论一个城市应该如何花钱。

sentences.en: The language becomes a tool for accomplishing something.
sentences.zh: 语言变成了完成某事的工具。

sentences.en: When I was studying Japanese in Tokyo, at graduate school, one of the classes I took was a debate class.
sentences.zh: 我在东京读研究生学日语时，我上的其中一门课是辩论课。

sentences.en: We had a curriculum. It involved studying grammar and vocabulary, but the main purpose of the class, each class, was to have a debate.
sentences.zh: 我们有课程大纲。它包括学习语法和词汇，但每节课的主要目的都是进行辩论。

sentences.en: We learned the language to use it as a tool for debating.
sentences.zh: 我们学习语言，是为了把它当作辩论的工具。

sentences.en: And I took another course at the same time on public speaking, which was similar.
sentences.zh: 我同时还上了另一门关于公开演讲的课程，也很相似。

sentences.en: We had a curriculum. But the main task over our course was to write a speech and present it in front of people Research into task-based language teaching has generally found positive effects on second language development.
sentences.zh: 我们有课程大纲。但我们课程中的主要任务是写一篇演讲稿并在大家面前展示它。对任务型语言教学的研究普遍发现其对第二语言的发展有积极的影响。

sentences.en: Although the size of those effects varies between studies, and there is still debate on how effective task-based learning is compared to other types of language instruction.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些影响的程度在不同研究之间有所差异，并且关于任务型学习与其他类型语言教学相比有多大效果，目前仍存在争论。

sentences.en: I think it would be good, or there is a need to mix curriculum-based education with communicative practices.
sentences.zh: 我认为将基于大纲的教育与交际练习结合起来会很好，或者说很有必要。

sentences.en: This is what I do. And it’s what I recommend people who join my Patreon do, or join my conversation clubs do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我正在做的。这也是我推荐加入我的Patreon或加入我的对话俱乐部的人们去做的事情。

sentences.en: Join the conversation club to practice speaking, join the conversation club to improve your confidence.
sentences.zh: 加入对话俱乐部来练习说话，加入对话俱乐部来提高你的自信。

sentences.en: But in your own time, at home, maybe take an English class with a teacher, use a textbook, build your skills, and then practice your skills in the conversation club.
sentences.zh: 但在你自己的时间里，在家时，也许可以跟着老师上一堂英语课，用用教科书，打牢你的技能，然后在对话俱乐部里练习你的技能。

sentences.en: You can’t just rely on one form of study to improve all of your English ability.
sentences.zh: 你不能只依靠一种学习形式来提高你所有的英语能力。

sentences.en: The structured curriculum can provide the knowledge, communication opportunities, gives you a reason to use your knowledge.
sentences.zh: 结构化的课程大纲可以提供知识，而交流机会则给了你使用知识的理由。

sentences.en: So where is the best place to learn English?
sentences.zh: 那么，学习英语的最佳地点在哪里？

sentences.en: I’ve looked at a lot of research in this episode, and ultimately the answer is… there isn’t a best place to learn English, but there are better and worse learning environments.
sentences.zh: 我在本期节目中查阅了很多研究，最终的答案是……并没有一个学英语的最佳地点，但确实有好坏之分的学习环境。

sentences.en: If you have the opportunity to study abroad, the evidence suggests that it can provide an advantage, particularly for your fluency.
sentences.zh: 如果你有机会出国留学，证据表明这可以带来优势，特别对你的流利度而言。

sentences.en: But simply being abroad is not enough. You need to interact with English, you need to immerse yourself in English.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅身处国外是不够的。你需要与英语互动，你需要让自己沉浸在英语中。

sentences.en: You need to use English to have that improvement.
sentences.zh: 你需要使用英语来获得那种提升。

sentences.en: A great English-speaking environment might look something like this: Taking an intensive course which has relatively small classes, regular opportunities to speak, individual feedback from a teacher, and plenty of English outside of the classroom.
sentences.zh: 一个绝佳的英语学习环境可能看起来像这样：参加一个班级相对较小、有定期发言机会、能从老师那里获得个人反馈、并且课外有大量英语输入的高强度课程。

sentences.en: Living with English speakers and developing friendships with English speakers can make your environment even stronger.
sentences.zh: 与英语母语者同住并与他们建立友谊，可以使你的环境更加强大。

sentences.en: But you don’t necessarily need to get on a plane to do that.
sentences.zh: 但你并不一定非得坐飞机去国外才能做到这一点。

sentences.en: A learner studying at home could combine high quality online or face-to-face lessons which contain some one-to-one feedback, and then use English language media, reading, writing, and maybe meetups or online chats to communicate with other English speakers.
sentences.zh: 在家里学习的学习者可以结合高质量的线上或线下课程（包含一些一对一的反馈），然后利用英语媒体、阅读、写作，也许还有聚会或在线聊天来与其他英语母语者沟通。

sentences.en: That could also be an extremely effective learning environment.
sentences.zh: 那也可以是一个极其高效的学习环境。

sentences.en: The location where you study English matters, but what you do with the location, the type of class you take, the type of curriculum you take, that matters much more.​
sentences.zh: 你学习英语的地点很重要，但你如何利用这个地点、你上什么类型的课、你采用什么类型的大纲，这些要重要得多。

sentences.en: The research suggests that what matters most to the success of your English learning is the learning environment.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，对你英语学习成功最重要的是学习环境。

sentences.en: You need good instruction, meaningful communication, regular feedback, and lots of opportunities to actually use English.
sentences.zh: 你需要良好的教学、有意义的交流、定期的反馈，以及大量真正使用英语的机会。

sentences.en: The best place for you to learn English is the place where you can spend the most time actively using English and learning new things in the most effective way.
sentences.zh: 对你来说学英语最好的地方，就是你能以最有效的方式花最多时间积极使用英语并学习新东西的地方。

sentences.en: If you could choose anywhere in the world to go and improve your English, where would you go, and why?
sentences.zh: 如果你可以去世界上任何地方提高英语，你会去哪里，为什么？
